newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Primac forms venture with Elders.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Primac forms venture with Elders.

text.p: Primac Holdings Ltd, under hostile takeover offer from Iama Ltd, said on Friday it had formed a joint venture with Elders Australia Ltd.

Primac, a Brisbane-based pastoral company, said it had agreed to form a Queensland-based joint venture with Elders which would begin operations from January 1 next year and be called Primac Elders Ltd.
It said the combination of the wool and livestock operations would have 51 branches in Queensland, with the Elders name to disappear from shop fronts.
The two companies would merge their wool operations in the Rocklea wool centre in Brisbane and their livestock selling operations would be also merged.
Primac said the joint venture followed nine months of negotiations and detailed financial analysis which had identified rationalisation benefits of A$4.1 million annually.

Primac said it would receive a goodwill payment of A$4.0 million from Elders due to the better profitability of Primac's business. Each company will receive A$2.0 million in goodwill from the joint venture operation and share equally all earnings.
Primac said its net assets to be transferred to the joint venture had a book value of about A$8.0 million at June 30.
